views.label: Upload, Scan Gate & Versioning
views.note: A version receives a SHA256 checksum. Production versions stay pending_scan until an external scanner marks them clean.

views.label: Expiry Alerts
views.note: Only categories with expiry tracking create renewal alerts. Renewal returns the document to active use.

views.label: Retention, Legal Hold & Scan Enforcement
views.note: Policy calculates retention. Scheduler quarantines failed scans and archives due documents; purge is explicit and hold blocks both.

cards.title: Versioned Private Storage
items: All uploaded documents stored in private tenant-isolated storage
Every added file creates an append-only version record with a SHA256 checksum
Document links use an allowlisted linkable type and an organization-scoped target

cards.title: Sensitivity & Download Gate
items: Five levels: org_internal, department_restricted, finance_confidential, hr_confidential, executive_confidential
Download checks organization, documents.download, sensitivity, clean scan status and every linked parent entity
Creating a document link requires visibility of its allowlisted parent entity

cards.title: Retention & Scan Enforcement
items: Expiry-enabled categories can notify the owner before expires_at
Category policy calculates retention_until, default renewal and mandatory legal hold
Scheduled enforcement quarantines failed scans and archives due documents; purge is explicit and legal hold blocks both
